ledger.what: remove cookie/consent chrome (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, generic cookie-banner ids/classes)
ledger.why: overlay chrome injected by a CMP, not page content; re-added at deploy time

ledger.what: de-carousel slick/swiper/splide/glide: remove clone slides, force real slides visible+static, drop dots/arrows
ledger.why: hidden slides are absent from innerText and clones duplicate it — rotating carousels break byte determinism; the reskin renders all slides statically in DOM order

ledger.what: expand NSW accordions: remove hidden="until-found" from .nsw-accordion__content, set aria-expanded=true
ledger.why: collapsed panels are absent from innerText — same class as N-D2 hidden slides; the reskin renders every panel body (Figma Accordion expanded variant 12362:10348)

ledger.what: remove Material Icons ligature spans (.material-icons: keyboard_arrow_down, east, north)
ledger.why: aria-hidden decorative glyphs whose ligature names leak into innerText; donor supplies its own chevron/arrow glyphs via CSS (mapping-brief § Icon-ligature text, "normalize it away")

visibleTextNormalized: Our Community Fort Street has a strong and supportive community of both past and present students and families. Fort Street Alumni Fort Street Alumni Community members of work with the school to archive and display important records, memorabilia and documents in our museum from all three schools throughout history. The Parents and Citizens Association (P&C) The P&C is highly active and contributes substantially to the life of Fort Street High School. It provides a forum which enables parents to get involved in the organisation and direction of the school. The Fort Street Foundation The Fort Street Foundation a registered charity and supports the school financially for initiatives including the development of buildings and facilities. The Fortians Union The Fortian Union began in 1894 and promotes social fellowship, reunions, assists the school and preserves its traditions. Have a question for our principal or teachers? Our friendly office team can help you get in touch. Contact us Learning Find out about our approach to learning and supporting students to progress. Travel to school Learn about local transport options and how to get here safely.
